question: Can native SSB fit all 8937 active detector terms with radius-consistent calibration and retain interactive controls and explicit overrides?

parameters.comparison_limit: Changed physical calibration and active workload. Not a same-workload speedup or regression against the 2464-active benchmark. Allocation is sampled, not continuous peak footprint. Entry registered during setup after process launch.

outputs.result: 30 native fit, calibration override, independent edit, exact reset, bookmark and FFT checks passed; screenshots and recording retained.
Eight fresh-process checks passed: full-aperture calibration and exact phase restored without refitting, then edits, revert, bookmark idempotence and restore. Process counts zero/one/zero.

results.qualification: Native workflow and focused Metal contracts passed; independent scientific phase validation and performance targets remain pending
results.limits: One full fit, not a repeated timing distribution. Not 20 seconds or 120 FPS. Sampled Metal allocation is not peak process footprint. BF radius supplied from audited fixture; automatic fitter unification is not implemented. Semi-angle assumed; rotation fixed. Other backends' calibration defaults are unchanged.
